opennyai_summary.decision:
When the petitioner preferred an  appeal being Criminal Appeal No.9 of 2010, the learned 2nd (Adhoc) Additional Sessions  Judge, Patan, vide judgment and order dated March 31, 2016, acquitted the original  accused for the offences with which he was charged.
It is pertinent to note that the Sessions Court  had directed the respondent original accused to furnish the bail bond in the sum of  Rs.5000/ (Rupees Five Thousand only) under section 437A of the Code of Criminal  Procedure, 1973, which shall be continued for a further period of six months.
A yadi be sent to the concerned Police Station forthwith.
